mentions.name: Tenex
mentions.description: Tenex is a TUI-based agent orchestrator for managing large fleets of AI coding agents. It tackles the 'review' bottleneck of working with 20+ agents at once, supports multi-project agent worktrees, and is adding Mac and Windows support (WSL for now, native later). Planned features include a mobile version and a meta-agent that can control Tenex over an API via tool calls to spawn and review agent fleets.
mentions.problem: Solving the 'review' bottleneck people experience when running many AI coding agents, and the difficulty of managing 20+ agents at once.

mentions.name: Tenex
mentions.description: A TUI for managing swarms of AI agents. It lets the user run ten review agents in parallel on code changes and aggregates their findings into a single agent that assesses and addresses them, with additional features added over time and first production use underway.
mentions.problem: Single-pass AI agent code reviews proved unreliable — the first review would catch nothing while a second would — which reduced confidence in agent capabilities when reviewing increasingly ambitious PRs.
mentions.audience: The comment frames use around reviewing pull requests with AI agents, i.e. developers working on software.
